rubrics.justification: Mostly reasonable but somewhat overcalls features not clearly visible in this single image. The embryo appears consistent with an early/full blastocyst with intact zona, but ICM and TE quality are not as confidently assessable as described, and the noted herniation/active hatching is speculative.

Integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, endometrium, sperm parameters, smoking, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis in a clinically meaningful way, though some factors are weighted more strongly than evidence clearly supports.

The structure is logical and the prognosis estimate generally follows from the stated factors. Minor issues include double-counting age-related aneuploidy after using an age-based baseline and assigning precise percentage adjustments without strong support.

Much of the discussion is broadly evidence-based, but several recommendations are not strongly guideline-supported for a first transfer, including routine low-dose aspirin, ERA/hysteroscopy framing after a single failure, thrombophilia screening, and strongly endorsing PGT-A as clearly improving live birth.

Provides clear practical next steps on smoking cessation, nutrition, luteal support review, alcohol reduction, and contingency planning. Some recommendations are useful but a few are more aggressive than typically indicated in this scenario.
